Step into effortless sophistication with this Natural Fawn Linen Hand-Embroidered Bandi Shirt. Crafted from premium linen in a soft natural Fawn shade, this ensemble features a structured Chinese collar and a clean buttoned front for a refined silhouette. The subtle floral hand embroidery on the chest and sleeves adds an elegant artisanal touch, while the rolled cuff detailing gives the design a relaxed contemporary finish. Ideal for festive celebrations, daytime weddings, cultural gatherings, and intimate occasions.
Key Features
Fabric: Premium linen with a lightweight and breathable feel
Color: Natural Fawn with subtle tonal embroidery
Detailing: Delicate floral hand embroidery on the chest and sleeves
Design: Chinese collar with a clean buttoned placket
Sleeves: Folded cuff detailing for a contemporary finish
Fit: Tailored silhouette for a polished and sophisticated look
Product: Hand-Embroidered Bandi Shirt
Styling Tips
Footwear: Pair with tan or brown loafers for a refined look, or opt for beige juttis for a traditional festive appeal.
Accessories: Style with a classic watch or minimal bracelet to complement the understated embroidery.
